cases.source_text:
For an optimal experience, all players should set it to the same value.

Off - Default behaviour
Menu only - Auto-pause only when opening the menu (not for deconstructions)
Never auto-pause - The game will never auto-pause, including when opening the menu. This can lead to save corruptions if you don't pause the game before saving.
